punchline: Plenty of MP3 players had more functions than the iPod, and the iPod still came to dominate them.
thirty_sec: In A Whole New Mind, Pink puts design first because products that merely work are everywhere. Summaries of the chapter cite the iPod, which took over from MP3 players with more functions. Pink suggests a design notebook: note good and bad design, and sketch a fix when something frustrates you.
